name: Amae Kozue
source: A fellow teacher at Usagino high school. She is often found in the dormitories before and after school cooking healthy meals for Shinusuke and the girls. Is kindhearted and gentle but can get angry and violent when provoked. She doesn't appreciate that Shinuske is trying to create a bunny club on campus full of girls in bunny suits.
